rv.q: It would be a fine achievement for any company anywhere to have staged this high quality, near-faultless show.
Get along to support these talented youngsters giving a slant to a story you thought you knew that, perhaps, you didn't.
Visually interesting at points but lacking substance.

cn.t: Critics split on this Cinderella retelling: one praises it as a refreshing, joyful departure from the Disney version, while another finds the reimagining less successful, resulting in sharply divided reception.
